Life Domain.description: Focuses on vitality, healing, and protection against disease and death.

1.name: Disciple of Life
1.tldr: Your healing spells are more effective, restoring extra hit points.

2.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
2.tldr: Use divine energy to heal severely injured targets within 30 feet.

6.name: Blessed Healer
6.tldr: When you cast a healing spell on others, you also regain hit points yourself.

8.name: Divine Strike
8.tldr: Infuse weapon strikes with radiant energy to deal extra damage once per turn.

17.name: Supreme Healing
17.tldr: Maximize the healing output of any healing spell you cast instead of rolling dice.

Light Domain.description: Wields intense radiant flames to banish darkness and sear enemies of the faith.

1.name: Warding Flare
1.tldr: Impose disadvantage on an attacker by flashing divine light in their eyes.

2.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
2.tldr: Emits a brilliant flash of light that banishes magical darkness and deals radiant damage to foes.

6.name: Improved Warding Flare
6.tldr: You can now use your Warding Flare to protect your allies as well as yourself.

8.name: Potent Spellcasting
8.tldr: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

17.name: Corona of Light
17.tldr: Emit a fiery aura of bright light that imposes disadvantage on saving throws against radiant or fire damage spells.
